field_checks.summary: Primary XML/PDF Table 1 and Table 2 were independently parsed: 49 expected MIC cells were represented in final activity records with no missing value, unit, peptide, or locator mismatch. Fig. 5 and Fig. 6 are explicitly accounted as excluded/non-tabular activity surfaces, while Supplement Fig. S13 contributes 13 approximate OD575 records.

Five database-candidate identity groups are present, but authoritative APD6/DBAASP/DRAMP linked rows are absent. Final status counts preserve this as 2 unresolved_record and 3 sequence_modified_not_normalized, with source_verified=0 and authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready=false; fallback rows are not release-ready.

All five paper-final JSON records were reviewed, and all same-name packet-final mirrors are byte-identical. Packet-only mechanism_evidence.json is the documented alias of mechanism_ontology_record.json. Live rework state has 8 request IDs and all are closed; review_report open_rework_ticket_count and packet_manifest open_rework_ticket_ids both resolve to zero.

Five mechanism claims were reviewed. Evidence classes remain separated as 1 direct_mechanism microscopy claim, 2 phenotype_supported claims, 1 inferred_mechanism claim, and 1 unknown_or_not_tested negative claim. Direct mechanism is limited to SEM/TEM morphology evidence and is not promoted to a unique molecular target.

Paper identity matches PMC12160004, PMID 40510052, DOI 10.1039/d5ra02745d, and the RSC Advances title. Source identity surfaces support A3 sequence NH2-CRRWRRRRC-OH, D-A3 as all-D-amino-acid analogue, and A3-C4/A3-C5/A3-C6 as triazole-ring cyclic variants without inventing normalized plain sequences for modified variants.

Final MIC rows preserve mass units as μg/mL and do not convert to molar units. Supplement Fig. S13 biofilm records are carried as approximate image digitizations with source-review status and direct OD575 preservation. A strict scan found no artifact-path values in source_locator/source_locators leaf fields, and no inspected object had a sequence/sequence_length disagreement.

Recursive locator hard findings from older tickets are closed in the live ticket state and no current final source_locator/source_locators leaf points to work/final/packet JSON as scientific authority. Fallback DBAASP/Codex machine rows remain candidate evidence only, and authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready remains false.

The final review's accepted_with_cautions status is warranted, but not sufficient for PASS because of the toxicity omission listed below. Preserved cautions include absent authoritative database links, approximate/ambiguous figure quantitation, and microscopy evidence that supports morphology alteration but not a unique molecular target.

The single staged supplement RA-015-D5RA02745D-s001.pdf is present, indexed, text/OCR extracted across 17 pages, and page-reviewed. No unrecoverable supplementary material gaps remain; supplementary_tables.json is empty but explicitly treated as nonblocking after visual review because the supplement surfaces are figures rather than structured tables.

Final toxicity records cover hemolysis and selected zebrafish hatching statements, but omit the source-reported zebrafish development/body-length surface in Fig. 11f and xml:p:40. No final toxicity record endpoint contains body length/fish length/development length, and no explicit exclusion covers that material in vivo toxicity field.

blocking_findings.reason: Layer-2 toxicity/selectivity coverage is incomplete. The primary source states that zebrafish body length was measured after treatment and Fig. 11f reports the 5-day development/body-length result; xml:p:40 specifically reports slight D-A3 body-length decrease at 6 μg/mL and no significant body-length differences for triazole-containing peptides versus A3/negative controls. Current final activity_toxicity_evidence.json has 11 toxicity records for hemolysis and hatching only, with no body-length/development-length record or explicit source-located exclusion, while review_report claims toxicity_source_surfaces_covered=true.
required_actions: Add a source-located toxicity/development coverage object for Fig. 11f body-length evidence, or add a source-located explicit exclusion explaining why no row-level record is scientifically supportable.

Preserve endpoint, treatment, target Danio rerio/zebrafish embryos, concentration/timepoint when source-supported, raw value/unit or qualitative/no-unit rationale, exact-vs-approximate status, and primary-source locators.
Update both final mirrors and worker-6 review_report so toxicity_source_surfaces_covered and final_counts reflect the repaired live state.
acceptance_checks: A read-only query over final/activity_toxicity_evidence.json returns at least one toxicity record or explicit exclusion whose endpoint/reason mentions zebrafish body length or Fig. 11f development length and whose source_locators include xml:p:40 and xml:fig:11.
The repaired object does not invent exact numeric body-length values unless they are digitized with approximate status and uncertainty or directly source-reported.

review_report semantic_quality_checks.open_rework_ticket_count equals the live packet rework state, rework_targets is empty only after this repair, and paper/packet final mirrors remain byte-identical for same-name JSON files.

cautions.summary: No authoritative APD6/DBAASP/DRAMP linked rows are present. Candidate DBAASP/Codex rows are preserved as unresolved or modified/not-normalized and must stay excluded from RC2/portal/authoritative ingest.
Supplement Fig. S13 OD575 values and zebrafish figure values are figure-derived or text-bound with approximation/ambiguity limitations; they should not be treated as exact tabular measurements.
SEM/TEM support direct morphology/ultrastructure alteration only; the final correctly avoids promoting this to a resolved molecular target or pathway.
